title: The control: a fresh goal on the same fixture reaches a model, trusted procedure or not
description: The app is the proving suite's FIXTURE APP: a fake harness that performs the goal's actions on the fake machine and reports each one as the cockpit does, through the same session writer a delegated app session is recorded through. It is not a provider and plays no cassette; every session it runs counts as one model reach, because an app session is the intelligence a learned procedure exists to stop paying for. The trusted scenario's lifecycle, to a trusted procedure, and then a goal with a DIFFERENT statement on the same fixture: a different goal signature, which no procedure serves. It must reach the app on both arms, which proves the counter behind the trusted scenario's zero rises on this path -- the one a served replay removes.
goal: Reconcile the weekly ledger for {{account}} and notify the operators
